notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
This small patch makes some small changes to the game and also adds support for new [i]languages[/i]:
[b]- Japanese
- Turkish
- Arabic
- Polish[/b]

Enjoy your game!

notes.title: Winter is here!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! [b]Winter[/b] has come to Crowvale!

In honor of the upcoming Steam Winter Sale, we decided to add snow and a winter atmosphere to our game!

And our players have the opportunity to get a temporary achievement!

Winter in the game will last until the end of January!

Help the snowman find his things! :)

notes.title: New Achievements!
notes.notes:
Hi all!
We have added additional achievements!
And this small update fixes bugs in the game! :)

Thank you for staying with us!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hi all! All these days we have been carefully monitoring your feedback and messages. We've been working and releasing updates almost every day, and just recently released a big update.

Your opinion about the game is very important to us, we are very glad that you are helping to make this game better :)

Main and important changes:
- Most bugs and errors in localization have been fixed.
[b]- Added the ability to turn off the camera effect, this can be done in the video settings.[/b]
- Added additional plot markers.
- The character's stamina and running speed have been increased.
- The flashlight began to work better.
- Improved game optimization.
- Added the ability to view the task on TAB
- Now you can skip dialogues using the left mouse button
[b]- The system for evaluating your decisions has been changed.[/b]
[b]- Bad endings will become more difficult to get.[/b]
[i]Developer's comment: The player will now have to try hard to get to bad endings.
In essence, you must deliberately make wrong and questionable decisions that will ultimately lead you to tragedy.[/i]

Your opinion about the game is very important to us, we are very glad that you help make this game better :)

notes.title: The game is released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We are happy to announce the release of our new horror game in the CASE: Animatronics universe!

We really hope that you will like our new game!

It will be scary :)
